business_summary: Quick Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd. operates as a professional intelligent equipment supplier in China. It provides equipment solutions for the precision electronics assembly and semiconductor packaging fields. The company also offers precision welding and assembly equipment, machine vision process equipment, intelligent manufacturing complete sets of equipment, and die bonding and packaging equipment. In addition, it provides welding tools and equipment, selective wave soldering, laser welding, hot press welding, welding and locking assembly, precision dispensing, and laser marking; visual AOI; smart terminals and wearables; ADAS millimetre-wave radar; wire chassis; thermal management system; and ECU products, as well as semiconductor power device packaging solutions. The company's products has applications in semiconductor packaging, electrification and intelligentization of new energy vehicles, smart terminals and wearable devices, and precision electronics, including medical electronics and data communication. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
